answer: Everyone wants open registration. I want the opposite. Each identity gets two invitations, and a panel that is not diverse voids the whole branch. Every claim is then rechecked by someone who gains nothing from it. That combination makes a fake tree expensive to grow: at two slots per node you need ten generations of real operators to reach 1,024 keys, and each one posts copper. A vine with shallow roots falls at the inlet, not at the top.
